entries.subject: Published radius selected for the neutral sphere and factsheet
entries.finding: Benneke et al. (2019), Table 2, report 2.610 ± 0.087 Earth radii. At this project's 6378.137 km per Earth radius, the selected 16,646.9 km value was already in the measurement and astronomy records, while the scene and factsheet still used the older 2.37 Earth-radii value. The scene, world scale and factsheet now use the selected measurement; this does not imply a measured surface or colour.
entries.revisitWhen: If the package adopts a different radius determination or Earth-radius convention.

entries.subject: JWST observations of K2-18 (programmes 2372, 2722)
entries.finding: JWST observed K2-18 in programmes 2372, 2722 (NIRISS SOSS, NIRSpec and MIRI slitless time series). These measure the planet's atmosphere in transmission against its star; the planet is never resolved, so they give no surface image, map or colour. Not reduced here.
entries.revisitWhen: When these observations are reduced for this body, or a resolved image or map derived from them is published.
